title: Contrastive Energy Prediction for Exact Energy-Guided Diffusion Sampling in Offline Reinforcement Learning

methods.one_paragraph_description: Q-Guided Policy Optimization: train (1) a diffusion behavior model mu(a|s) (following SfBC), (2) an action-evaluation critic Q trained by in-support softmax Q-learning over a pre-generated support action set of K samples per state, and (3) an intermediate energy guidance model f(s,a_t,t) trained with contrastive energy prediction (CEP) against beta*Q on the support set. At runtime, sample a single action from the diffusion model with DPM-Solver (15 steps), guided by the gradient of the energy model scaled by guidance scale s; no candidate resampling (1 action candidate).
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: offline RL with diffusion-based policies / energy-guided diffusion sampling ('recent advances in offline RL that adopt diffusion-based policies')

diffusion_steps.quote: We use the second-order sampler and report performance scores at a diffusion step of 15.

sampler.quote: In order to sample from the learned diffusion-based policy, we adopt a recent advance in diffusion sampling, namely DPM-Solver (Lu et al., 2022b). We use the second-order sampler and report performance scores at a diffusion step of 15.

support_actions_K.quote: We set βQ = 1 and K = 16 for MuJoCo Locomotion tasks, βQ = 20 and K = 32 for AntMaze tasks in Eq. (22).

beta_Q.quote: We set βQ = 1 and K = 16 for MuJoCo Locomotion tasks, βQ = 20 and K = 32 for AntMaze tasks in Eq. (22).

beta_energy_guidance.quote: The size support action set is the same as the one used in training the action evaluation model (K = 16 for MuJoCo Locomotion and K = 32 for AntMaze), though we set β = 3 in all tasks.

guidance_scale_sweep.quote: To choose the optimal energy guidance scales s for action sampling, we sweep over [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0, 8.0, 10.0] for MuJoCo Locomotion and [1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 4.0] for AntMaze tasks during evaluation (Figure 4).
